mpremote connect /dev/ttyACM0 repl

ESP32-S3 N16R8 -> PCM5102A (I2S)



// =====================================================================================//
// ============================ Start Update files on  flash mem  ======================//
// =====================================================================================//

// list files on ESP 
// ****************//
mpremote connect /dev/ttyACM0 ls
mpremote connect /dev/ttyACM0 ls /media

// view files on ESP 
// ****************//
mpremote connect /dev/ttyACM0 cat boot.py
mpremote connect /dev/ttyACM0 cat config.json

// check free disk space
mpremote exec "import os; s=os.statvfs('/'); print(f'Свободно: {s[0]*s[4]/1024/1024:.2f} MB из {s[0]*s[2]/1024/1024:.2f} MB')"

// Syncronze one file from current filder to ESP32 flash disk
// *******************************************************************************//
mpremote connect /dev/ttyACM0 cp main.py :main.py

// Syncronze one file from ESP32 flash disk to current filder
// *******************************************************************************//
mpremote connect /dev/ttyACM0 cp -r :boot.log boot.log

// Syncronze all files from current filder and sub folders to ESP32 flash disk
// *******************************************************************************//
mpremote connect /dev/ttyACM0 cp -r . : && mpremote connect /dev/ttyACM0 soft-reset


// backup all files from ESP32 flash disk to current filder 
// *******************************************************************************//
mpremote cp -r :. ./backup/

/************** delete file from ESP32 *******************/
// *******************************************************************************//
mpremote connect /dev/ttyACM0 rm :webrepl_cfg.py


// ####################################################################################//
// ############################# END Update files on  flash mem #######################//
// ####################################################################################//

// =====================================================================================//
// =============================        Start ESP32 Utils   ============================//
// =====================================================================================//

picocom /dev/ttyACM0 -b 115200

mpremote connect /dev/ttyACM0 repl

mpremote soft-reset

// full ESP32 board spec
esptool.py --port /dev/ttyACM0 flash_id

// to linux cli
rshell -p /dev/ttyACM0
ls /pyboard

mpremote cp -r :. ./backup/

// ####################################################################################//
// #############################        End Start ESP32 Utils   #######################//
// ####################################################################################//


// =====================================================================================//
// ==============================   Update Start firmware    ===========================//
// =====================================================================================//

// clear internal flash mem
// ****************//
python3 -m esptool --chip esp32s3 --port /dev/ttyACM0 erase_flash

// compile 
// ****************//
cd /media/topasta/Dev/git/Esp32Firmware/micropython/ports/esp32
make BOARD=ESP32_GENERIC_S3 BOARD_VARIANT=SPIRAM_OCT USER_C_MODULES=/media/topasta/Dev/git/Esp32Firmware/Custom/mp3dec/micropython.cmake

// set new firmware
// ****************//
cd /media/topasta/Dev/git/Esp32Firmware/micropython/ports/esp32/build-ESP32_GENERIC_S3-SPIRAM_OCT
python3 -m esptool --chip esp32s3 --port /dev/ttyACM0 -b 460800 --before no_reset --after hard_reset write_flash "@flash_args"

// set old firmware
// ****************//
cd /media/topasta/Dev/ESP32/firmware
python3 -m esptool --chip esp32s3 --port /dev/ttyACM0 -b 460800 write_flash 0x0 ESP32_GENERIC_S3-SPIRAM_OCT-20240602-v1.23.0.bin

// ####################################################################################//
// ##################################  End Update firmware  ###########################//
// ####################################################################################//


// =====================================================================================//
// ==============================  Start Build new firmware  ===========================//
// =====================================================================================//


// ####################################################################################//
// ###############################  End Build new firmware  ###########################//
// ####################################################################################//

--------------- Подготовка системы и установка базовых зависимостей -------------------

sudo apt update
sudo apt install -y git wget flex bison gperf python3 python3-pip python3-venv cmake ninja-build ccache libffi-dev libssl-dev dfu-util libusb-1.0-0

1. Создаем структуру папок и переходим в базовую директорию:
    mkdir -p ~/Esp32Firmware/Custom/mp3dec
    cd ~/Esp32Firmware
2. Скачиваем ESP-IDF
    git clone -b v5.3.1 --recursive https://github.com/espressif/esp-idf.git
3. установку компиляторов (инструментов сборки) специально для нашего чипа ESP32-S3:
    cd esp-idf
    ./install.sh esp32s3

----------------- Активация ESP-IDF и скачивание MicroPython ----------------------

4.  Активируйте переменные среды ESP-IDF:
    . ./export.sh
5. Перейдите в базовую папку и клонируйте репозиторий MicroPython:
    cd ~/Esp32Firmware
    git clone https://github.com/micropython/micropython.git
6. Перейдите в папку MicroPython и скачайте внешние зависимости (подмодули):
    cd micropython
    git submodule update --init --recursive

---------------- Подготовка конфигурации для C-модуля (mp3dec) ----------------------
7.  Соберите кросс-компилятор mpy-cross:
    make -C mpy-cross
8. Подготовка конфигурации для C-модуля (mp3dec)
    cd ~/Esp32Firmware/Custom/mp3dec ??????????????????????????
    wget https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lieff/minimp3/master/minimp3.h

------------------- Сборка прошивки MicroPython -----------------------------------
9. Скачайте специфичные для ESP32 подмодули (библиотеки):
    cd ~/Esp32Firmware/micropython/ports/esp3
    make submodules
    

10. Запустите компиляцию с указанием платы, типа памяти и вашего кастомного модуля:
    cd Esp32Firmware/micropython/ports/esp32
    make BOARD=ESP32_GENERIC_S3 BOARD_VARIANT=SPIRAM_OCT USER_C_MODULES=~/Esp32Firmware/Custom/mp3dec/micropython.cmake

/************** delete file *******************/

mpremote connect /dev/ttyACM0 rm :webrepl_cfg.py

/*************** delete dir with contains *********************/

mpremote connect /dev/ttyACM0 exec "
import os
def rm_rf(d):
    try:
        for entry in os.ilistdir(d):
            path = d + '/' + entry[0]
            if entry[1] == 0x4000:
                rm_rf(path)
            else:
                os.remove(path)
        os.rmdir(d)
        print('Удалена директория:', d)
    except Exception as e:
        print('Ошибка:', e)

rm_rf('.vscode')
"

/******************* tree **********************/

mpremote connect /dev/ttyACM0 exec "
import os

def print_tree(path='/', prefix=''):
    try:
        entries = sorted(os.ilistdir(path), key=lambda x: x[0])
    except Exception:
        return
    for i, entry in enumerate(entries):
        name = entry[0]
        is_dir = (entry[1] == 0x4000)
        is_last = (i == len(entries) - 1)
        connector = '└── ' if is_last else '├── '
        print(prefix + connector + name + ('/' if is_dir else ''))
        if is_dir:
            subpath = path + '/' + name if path != '/' else '/' + name
            new_prefix = prefix + ('    ' if is_last else '│   ')
            print_tree(subpath, new_prefix)

print('/')
print_tree('/')
"
